requirements.behavior: A version-controlled Design System Manifest defines named tokens for color, typography, spacing, iconography, motion, component anatomy and every state, responsive and accessibility adaptations, and named rendering layers. Every component and screenshot baseline identifies the manifest version it follows.

requirements.behavior: Programmatic-first opening identity sequence with a skip control, local versioned assets only, and no dependency on runtime image generation, an AI call, a remote animation service, an iframe, a third-party script, or a WebGL-only effect. Decorative assets stay off the critical path and within the stated budgets, and the sequence remains usable under cache miss, reduced motion, autoplay denial, and individual asset failure.

requirements.verification: tests/e2e/phase1-shell.spec.ts (semantic title present independently, skip control, prefers-reduced-motion, no replay on in-app navigation)

requirements.behavior: Stable routes /legal/terms, /legal/privacy, /legal/alpha-participation, and /legal/content-and-safety load without authentication as ordinary accessible documents showing title, version, effective date, stable anchors, and a contact path. Opening a legal link preserves pending invitation and form state.

Recording a player's acceptance of a specific version is deferred to the chunk that adds an account-creation flow to attach it to.

systemContinuityCheck.note: Section 25.0 requires an architectural compatibility answer for every domain, not scaffolding for future features. This will be completed as Phase 1 slices land; the entries below record the position Phase 1 starts from.

domains.squareGridTacticsAnd3dGeometry: NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED — NO CONFLICT INTRODUCED. Phase 1 introduces no coordinate model, and the greenfield scan continues to block an alternate topology or compatibility switch before Phase 2 authors the single five-foot square model.
domains.canonicalCommandEventProjectionAuthority: PARTIAL — COMPATIBLE. Phase 0 established server-authorized intent with request-id idempotency and page rendering bound to server projections. Phase 1 extends that shape to characters, campaigns, and seats; Phase 2 builds the full command and event core on it.
domains.multiplayerSeatsPresenceReconnectOwnersh: IN SCOPE (partial). Phase 1 implements account-bound ownership, campaign membership, and server-created seats, and proves persistence across leave and return. Presence, reconnect, and realtime sync belong to Phases 2 and 4.
domains.deterministicSrdRulesEngine: PARTIAL — COMPATIBLE. Phase 1 validates character legality against the approved SRD manifest and computes derived values, but implements no adjudication, dice, or combat. Phase 3 owns the engine.
domains.aiDirectorIntentRulingNarrationIsolation: NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED — NO CONFLICT INTRODUCED. Phase 1 persists a locked Director identity and personality as campaign configuration and exposes no AI behavior of any kind.
domains.campaignPersistenceAndMemory: PARTIAL — COMPATIBLE. Campaign records, membership, and settings persist. Campaign memory and the chapter model belong to Phase 5.
domains.playerAndCampaignSettings: IN SCOPE. The settings data model is authored here, exposing only controls with real Phase 1 behavior while reserving stable defaults for later speech and AI presentation settings.
domains.communicationSurfacesAndSafety: IN SCOPE (structural). Chronicle, Party Chat, Rules Desk, and the Action Composer are established as separate surfaces with real Phase 1 behavior only.
domains.accessibilityBrowserBehaviorDegradedMode: IN SCOPE (foundations). Keyboard operation, focus management, live regions, reduced motion, and high zoom are foundations here. Full browser and device certification is Phase 6.
domains.securityPrivacyProviderPolicyHiddenInfor: PARTIAL — COMPATIBLE. Phase 0 guards remain active and the architecture conformance scan now enforces the account model mechanically. Provider policy and hidden-information projections arrive with the features that need them.
domains.artAudioPerformanceRenderingLayerOwnersh: PARTIAL — COMPATIBLE. Design System Manifest v1 and a DOM Render Layer Registry are authored and implemented (shell, page-content, intro-overlay, live-region), with one original interim SVG motif and an honestly labeled interim typography substitution pending licensed font bundling. Production art and audio are Phase 5.
